name: The stones of Drak’Zin
summary: Among the weathered faces and broken terraces of Drak’Zin, Drakuru’s image studies the carved walls. He says a legendary set of artifacts was made to render Drak’Tharon Keep impervious, and that hieroglyphs may reveal where one lies. Drakuru alone offers this claim, and its truth remains unverified. He had been captured while interpreting the old stones. Now the ruins become the first test of whether his knowledge is a path toward safety or another kind of trap.
